appearance.title: Appearance & startup
appearance.desc: "Follow system" tracks your OS light/dark setting live; your choice is kept in this browser and survives reloads.

language.title: Interface language
language.desc: Applies immediately without reload; your choice is stored in this browser.

autostart.label: Launch at login
autostart.desc: Start the LanDeck console automatically when you log into this computer.

silent.label: Silent start
silent.desc: On boot, runs in the tray without showing a window; opening from the tray or the shortcut still shows it.
silent.onDesc: Next boot stays in the tray; opening the shortcut manually still shows the window.
silent.offDesc: Next boot shows the window normally.

lightweight.label: Lightweight mode
lightweight.desc: Closing the window releases UI memory, keeping only background services in the tray; reopening rebuilds the UI (data is cached locally, so it shows again instantly).
lightweight.onDesc: Closing the window releases UI memory, keeping only the tray and background service; reopening rebuilds the UI (data still shows instantly).
lightweight.offDesc: The UI stays in the background after closing; reopening is instant.

appearance.autoDesc: Launch the LanDeck console automatically when you sign in to this PC.
appearance.silent.label: Silent start
appearance.lightweight.label: Lightweight mode

about.title: About
about.desc: Agent version, API contract entry and port conventions.
about.sessionError: Failed to read the device session
about.clipboardDenied: The browser denied clipboard access — select and copy the address manually
about.fieldNote: docs/API.md in the repo is the single source of truth; this document is frozen at Agent v1.
about.portHttp: HTTP API + WebSocket + embedded Web UI

identity.title: This console's identity
identity.desc: This name is shown to the controlled machine when pairing, to tell consoles apart.

update.downloading: Downloading and installing the new version; the app restarts when done…
update.foundToast: You can update to the latest version.
update.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
update.autoOnDesc: Checks quietly in the background 10s after launch; new versions are only noted in "About".
update.autoOffDesc: No automatic checks; you can check manually here anytime.
update.autoSetFailed: Failed to set auto update check

gate.pairDesc: These settings act on a controlled machine's agent. Scan the LAN first and pair with the passcode or fixed key.
gate.authDesc: The token is invalid or lacks access — pair again to change settings.
gate.unreachable: {{name}}: {{err}}. Make sure it is powered on, the agent is running, and it is on the same LAN.

agentCard.title: Agent settings
agentCard.desc: The phone acts as a console only — there is no local agent to configure.
agentCard.line1: To change "{{name}}"’s device name, port or power-on behavior, open LanDeck on that machine,
agentCard.line2: or open its detail page from "Devices".

startupToast.autostartFailed: Failed to set launch at login

lang.title: Interface language
lang.desc: Applies instantly. When following the system, the OS language decides — AI summaries follow it too.
